messages:
rachel: quick flag from product — canary cost card hides cache wins. they want a compact per-variant snapshot that shows billed tokens vs KV cache savings so PMs can understand net impact. screenshot attached. :eyes:

samir: +1. If we surface tokens_billed, cache_saved_tokens, and net_cost_cents per variant and a normalized net_delta_per_1k_invokes the comparisons will be much clearer across different traffic levels.

sid: Implementation proposal: producers emit a single compact snapshot at snapshot_time. POST /internal/v1/snapshots accepts array of rows: route,variant,invocations,tokens_billed,cache_saved_tokens,token_cost_cents,baseline_snapshot_id,reasons[],approx, sample_size. No full timeseries re-ingest required. We'll sign snapshot blob for audit and store immutable.

anya: UX: render paired bars (red = spend, green = cache savings as negative). add per-invocation/per-token toggle and a per-1k normalized metric. show an "approximate" badge when approx=true and include sample_size in tooltip. CSV export please.

samir: for explainability product asked for a top_reason enum (model_swap|token_shift|prompt_change) + confidence. Heuristics should be simple and transparent.

sid: heuristic sketch: if variant_id != baseline -> model_swap. if median tokens shift > 20% -> token_shift. if prompt token overlap < 60% -> prompt_change. Confidence = function(sample_size, magnitude). mark approx=true if sample_size < 200.

ingest-bot: snapshot recorded rollout=canary-2026-05-02T10:12Z by @rachel (5 rows uploaded)

samir: action items: sid -> draft endpoint proto + example payloads (ETA Tue), anya -> mock UI + CSV (ETA Wed), rachel -> update runbook and retention request. keeping this thread as decision log. :thumbsup:
